title: Implement a typeahead search box using debounceTime, distinctUntilChanged, and switchMap
hint: Pipe the input's valueChanges through debounceTime, distinctUntilChanged and switchMap to the search API so stale requests are cancelled.

title: Call three APIs in parallel and combine the results using forkJoin, handling a failure in one of them
hint: Pass the three observables to forkJoin and wrap each in catchError returning a default value so one failure does not cancel the others.

title: Cache an HTTP response in a service using shareReplay so that multiple subscribers cause a single call
hint: Store the HTTP observable in a field piped through shareReplay(1) so later subscribers reuse the cached emission rather than triggering new calls.

title: Prevent double-submit on a save button using exhaustMap
hint: Pipe the click stream through exhaustMap into the save call, so new clicks are ignored while a save is in progress.
